definitions.de: Entwickeln; etwas verbessern oder ausbauen; Fortschritt machen
definitions.en: To develop; to improve or advance something; to make progress
definitions.es: Desarrollar; mejorar o avanzar algo; progresar
definitions.fr: Développer; améliorer ou faire progresser quelque chose; progresser
definitions.hi: विकास करना; किसी चीज़ को सुधारना या आगे बढ़ाना; प्रगति करना
definitions.ja: 発展させる；何かを改善または進歩させる；発達する
definitions.km: អភិវឌ្ឍ; កែលម្អ ឬផ្លាស់ប្តូររឿងអ្វីមួយ; ធ្វើឱ្យប្រសើរឡើង
definitions.ne: विकास गर्नु; केही सुधार्नु वा अगाडि बढाउनु; प्रगति गर्नु
definitions.pt: Desenvolver; melhorar ou avançar algo; progredir
definitions.th: พัฒนา; ปรับปรุงหรือส่งเสริมบางสิ่ง; ก้าวหน้า
definitions.tl: Paunlarin; pagbutihin o isulong ang isang bagay; umunlad
definitions.ur: ترقی کرنا؛ کسی چیز کو بہتر بنانا یا آگے بڑھانا
definitions.vi: Phát triển; cải thiện hoặc thúc đẩy điều gì đó; tiến bộ
definitions.zh: 发展；改善或推动某事；取得进步
definitions.zh_Hant: 發展；改善或推動某事；取得進步

definition_en: To develop; to improve or advance something; to make progress

lao_examples.lao_script: ລາວຢາກພັດທະນາຕົນເອງໃຫ້ດີຂຶ້ນທຸກວັນ
lao_examples.romanization: lao yak phat-tha-na ton-eng hai di khun thuk wan
lao_examples.translation_en: He/She wants to develop themselves and get better every day.

lao_examples.lao_script: ບ້ານເຮົາພັດທະນາໄວຫຼາຍໃນຊ່ວງ 10 ປີມານີ້
lao_examples.romanization: ban hao phat-tha-na wai lai nai suang sip pi ma ni
lao_examples.translation_en: Our village has developed very quickly in the past 10 years.
